packageRules.description: Go: group minor+patch module updates into one weekly PR; majors stay separate for review

web/lint-ts's typescript pin is a deliberate TS 6.x side-by-side shim so typescript-eslint (which does not support TS >=7, see typescript-eslint#10940) can keep linting the project's real TS 7 sources. Do not propose bumping it until that upstream issue closes (#128).

BombVault's OWN published image stays on the floating :latest tag, never a pinned digest. docker:pinDigests (above) is right for build INPUTS — the golang base image in the Dockerfile — but deploy/docker-compose.generic.yml is a file users copy to RUN BombVault, and the Unraid CA template it mirrors installs :latest. A digest there freezes every copy of that file on one build forever, so nobody receives an update, and it silently drifts from the template. Renovate proposed exactly that in #168, which was closed rather than merged.
